app.name: SavePoint
app.placeholder.heading: Keep the setup that works
error.capture.cancelled: Saving was canceled. Everything you saved earlier is untouched, so you can save again whenever you're ready.
error.catalog.corrupt: SavePoint couldn't read the file where it keeps your games and profiles, so it left the file exactly as it is. Restore the backup copy next to it (the same name ending in .bak) if there is one, or move the file away to start again with no games listed.
error.compaction.cancelled: Optimizing storage was canceled. Nothing was lost, and you can run it again any time.
error.consentMarker.conflict: That folder is already tracked by a different game in SavePoint.
error.consentMarker.missing: This folder has not been confirmed for SavePoint yet. Save again to confirm it.
error.diskSpace.low: There's not enough free disk space to save this profile right now.
error.gameService.gameRunning: {gameName} is running right now, so SavePoint can't do that yet. Close the game, then try again.
error.gameService.pathOverlap: That folder overlaps with {conflictingGameName}, which you already track. Pick a different location for one of them.
error.gameService.profileActive: This is the currently active profile. Switch to a different one before deleting it.
error.gameService.reconnectable: That folder has saved history from a game that's no longer in your library. Try adding it as a new game, or point it somewhere else.
error.git.unavailable: SavePoint can't run the built-in tool it uses to save and restore your files. Reinstall SavePoint to repair it, then open the app again.
error.gitOperation.amendNotAvailable: This profile can't be updated that way right now. Try creating a new profile instead.
error.gitOperation.checkoutFailed: A file is in use, so the switch stopped partway. Something else on your computer is holding one of the game's files open. Close the game, its launcher and any mod manager, then try again — SavePoint picks up where it left off and won't redo the work it already finished.
error.launch.detachedCaptureNotSupported: You're viewing an older save of this profile. Switch it back to the latest save before keeping new progress.
error.launch.dirtyWorkingTree: There are unsaved changes in the way - resolve them and try again.
error.launch.noActiveSession: SavePoint isn't tracking a play session for this game right now. Start the game from SavePoint to begin one.
error.launch.sessionStillRunning: The game is still running. Close it, then try again.
error.launch.spawnFailed: SavePoint couldn't start the game. Check the launch settings in Edit game.
error.path.missing: This game's folder has moved or is gone. SavePoint still has everything it saved for this game, but it can't find the {role, select, install {install folder} external {saves folder} other {folder}} anymore. Point it at the new location to carry on.
error.pathSafety.tier1Blocked: That folder is too broad to track. Pick the game's own folder rather than the whole drive or {os, select, windows {a Windows folder} macos {a macOS system folder} other {a system folder}} — SavePoint replaces everything inside whatever you point it at, so it won't work on a location this large.
error.pathSafety.tier2Blocked: That folder is too broad to track. Pick the game's own folder rather than the whole drive or {os, select, windows {a Windows folder} macos {a macOS system folder} other {a system folder}} — SavePoint replaces everything inside whatever you point it at, so it won't work on a location this large.
error.storageRelocation.cancelled: Moving your storage was canceled. You can try again from Settings.
error.storageRelocation.destinationNotEm: That folder already has files in it. Choose an empty folder for your storage.
error.validation.invalidPayload: Some of these fields aren't valid yet. Check the name and paths above.
validation.game.externalPathRequired: Choose the folder where the saves live, or remove the saves location.
validation.game.externalRoleInvalid: SavePoint doesn't recognize that kind of save location.
validation.game.idInvalid: A game ID can only use letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores, and it has to start with a letter or number.
validation.game.idRequired: This game is missing its ID.
validation.game.installPathRequired: Choose the folder where the game is installed.
validation.game.pathsNested: The game folder and the saves folder can't be inside each other. Pick two separate folders.
validation.game.schemaVersionUnsupported: This game's file was made for a different version of SavePoint, so it can't be used here.
validation.launch.exePathAbsolute: Enter the start file's location relative to the game folder, not a full path.
validation.launch.exePathEscapes: The start file has to be inside the game folder, so its path can't use .. to climb out of it.
validation.launch.exePathRequired: Choose the file that starts the game.
validation.launch.methodInvalid: Choose how SavePoint should start the game.
validation.launch.uriInvalid: That doesn't look like a launch link. It should begin with a name and a colon, such as steam://.
validation.launch.uriRequired: Enter the launch link that starts the game, such as steam://run/123456.
validation.path.invalidCharacter: That folder location has a colon in a place it can't go. Pick the folder again.
validation.path.notAbsolute: Enter the folder's full location, starting from the top of the drive.
validation.path.unknownToken: SavePoint doesn't recognize that shortcut in the folder location, or it isn't available on this computer.
validation.profile.branchNameInvalid: This profile's internal name can only use letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores and single slashes, and it can't begin with a hyphen or slash, or end with a slash.
validation.profile.branchNameRequired: This profile is missing the internal name SavePoint uses to keep its history.
validation.profile.gameIdRequired: This profile isn't linked to a game.
validation.profile.idRequired: This profile is missing its ID.
validation.settings.accentColorInvalid: Pick one of the accent colors from the list.
validation.settings.layoutInvalid: Pick the Sidebar or the Library layout.
validation.settings.localeInvalid: That language isn't valid. Pick one from the list.
validation.settings.storageRootRequired: Choose a folder for SavePoint's storage.
validation.settings.themeInvalid: Pick Light, Dark, or the theme that matches your system.
